title: 第7章 加点突破第8章 步入正轨
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界
content_zh:
次日，李北玄从醉意之中醒来。
当他再次查看自己的数据面板时，突然间醉意全无，整个人瞬间变得清醒无比。
因为他看到自己的数据面板终于是有了变化！
姓名：李北玄
家族：北源李氏
境界：先天初期（99100）+
寿元：25天
李氏族人：109人，其中锻体期86人，后天境初期9人，中期7人，后期4人，后天圆满1人，先天境初期2人。
修为点：20
首先是在境界栏后面多了个+号，应该是对应下面的修为点，表示能够加点提升境界了。
从李氏族人那栏的变化，也能够看出有族人突破境界了。
“后天初期由原来的10变为了现在的9人，而后天中期人数也多了一人！”
“也就是说有一名族人从后天初期突破到了后天中期！”
“那么这名突破的族人大概便是李青山了！”李北玄看着数据面板呢喃道。
历经11天，见到有族人突破境界，使得他终于是松了一口气。
“终于是能够加点了，仅仅只是一名族人突破，便有20个修为点。
那么便让我看看加点突破境界之后，是否能够增加寿元？”
想到这，李北玄将手指伸到数据面板上，在境界栏的+号上轻轻一点。
便只见他的数据面板的信息又有改变了。
姓名：李北玄

家族：北源李氏
境界：先天中期（0200）+
寿元：108天
李氏族人：109人，其中锻体期86人，后天境初期9人，中期7人，后期4人，后天圆满1人，先天境初期2人。
修为点：19
看着自己已经发生了变化的数据面板，李北玄不禁激动起来。
“寿元果然增加了，只要我的境界不断突破，那么我就可以一直活下去了！”
他终于是在这个天崩的开局之中看到了一些盼头。
就在这时！
突然间，一阵暖流在他的身躯经脉之中流动，使得他一身舒爽。
身体那种苍老虚弱的感觉也都随着一扫而空！
只见他面色潮红，脸上也都恢复了红润，完全没了昨天的那般气色！
整个人看上去也是颇为精神！
“爽！”
李北玄轻吐一口气，他感觉到了前所未有的舒服。
他忍不住放声大笑起来：“哈哈哈，青山那小子果然没让我失望，希望接下来的两三个月，其他族人也能给我些惊喜！”
“现在看来，加点的效果非常不错，只可惜族人有点少了！”
说到底还是他们李家规模太小了，族中的后天修士也是少得可怜。
李北玄将杂念甩开，剩下的修为点也不足以让他提升境界，索性便挥手将数据面板给收了起来。
“唉！看来想要变强，任重道远啊！”
content_en:
The next day, Li Beixuan woke up from drunkenness.
When he checked his data panel again, his drunkenness suddenly disappeared and he instantly became sober.
Because he saw that his data panel finally changed!
Name: Li Beixuan
Family: Beiyuan Li family
Realm: Early stage of Xiantian (99100) +
Longevity: 25 days
Li clan members: 109 people, including 86 in the physical training stage, 9 in the early stage of acquired heaven, 7 in the middle stage, 4 in the late stage, 1 in the acquired perfection stage, and 2 in the early stage of innate stage.
Cultivation points: 20
First of all, there is an extra + sign behind the realm column, which should correspond to the cultivation points below, indicating that you can add points to improve your realm.
From the changes in the column of the Li clan members, we can also see that some clan members have broken through the realm.
"The number of people in the early stage of the day after tomorrow has increased from 10 to 9 now, and the number of people in the middle stage of the day after tomorrow has also increased by one!"
"That is to say, one clan member has broken through from the early stage of the day after tomorrow to the middle stage of the day after tomorrow!"
"Then the tribesman who made the breakthrough is probably Li Qingshan!" Li Beixuan murmured while looking at the data panel.
After 11 days, he finally breathed a sigh of relief when he saw someone from his tribe breaking through.
"Finally, I can add points. Just one clan member's breakthrough will give him 20 cultivation points.
So let me see if I can increase my longevity by adding some points to break through the realm? "
Thinking of this, Li Beixuan stretched out his finger on the data panel and tapped lightly on the + sign in the realm column.
Then he saw that the information on his data panel had changed again.
Name: Li Beixuan
Family: Beiyuan Li family
Realm: Intermediate Xiantian (0200) +
Longevity: 108 days
Li clan members: 109 people, including 86 in the physical training stage, 9 in the early stage of acquired heaven, 7 in the middle stage, 4 in the late stage, 1 in the acquired perfection stage, and 2 in the early stage of innate stage.
Cultivation points: 19
Looking at his changed data panel, Li Beixuan couldn't help but get excited.
"My longevity has indeed increased. As long as my realm continues to break through, I can live forever!"
He finally saw some hope in this devastating start.
Right now!
Suddenly, a warm current flowed through the meridians of his body, making him feel comfortable.
The feeling of oldness and weakness in the body was also swept away!
I saw that his face was flushed, and his face had returned to rosy. He was completely gone like yesterday!
The whole person looks quite energetic!
"It's cool!"
Li Beixuan let out a breath, feeling more comfortable than ever before.
He couldn't help but laugh loudly: "Hahaha, that boy from Qingshan really didn't disappoint me. I hope that other clan members can also give me some surprises in the next two or three months!"
"Now it seems that the effect of adding more points is very good, but it's a pity that there are a little few people!"
After all, the Li family is too small, and there are very few acquired monks in the family.
Li Beixuan shook off his distracting thoughts. The remaining cultivation points were not enough for him to improve his level, so he simply waved his hand and put away the data panel.
"Alas! It seems that if you want to become stronger, you still have a long way to go!"
